<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="blur" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="28"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="8"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="0" y="42" width="390" height="602" fill="#111111"/>

  <g opacity="0.45" filter="url(#blur)">
    <circle cx="195" cy="257" r="145" fill="#455154"/>
    <circle cx="137" cy="181" r="66" fill="#979797"/>
    <circle cx="266" cy="342" r="91" fill="#434343"/>
    <rect x="36" y="472" width="318" height="96" rx="48" fill="#50555C"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="0" y="42" width="390" height="602" fill="#000000" opacity="0.48"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="26" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="600">9:41</text>
  <line x1="327" y1="20" x2="332" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="327" y1="17" x2="332" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="327" y1="14" x2="332" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="21" x2="340" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="17" x2="343" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="349" cy="18" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="359" y="12" width="23" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="361" y="14" width="17" height="8" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="383" y="16" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- translucent top call bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="42" width="390" height="58" fill="#111111" opacity="0.72"/>
  <polyline points="30,65 21,72 30,79" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="21" y1="72" x2="43" y2="72" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="354" cy="72" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF1F"/>
  <circle cx="349" cy="69" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="349" cy="78" rx="7" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <circle cx="362" cy="64" r="3" fill="#5AD439" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- contact -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="222" r="78" fill="#00000080" filter="url(#soft)"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="222" r="70" fill="#50555C"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="201" r="24" fill="#A4AAB2"/>
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="250" rx="42" ry="28" fill="#8E8E93"/>
  <circle cx="251" cy="274" r="13" fill="#5AD439" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="4"/>
  <text x="195" y="342" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Display, SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="700">Martha Craig</text>
  <text x="195" y="368" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="400">Calling...</text>
  <text x="195" y="392" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF59" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Messenger</text>

  <!-- call action tray -->
  <rect x="25" y="484" width="340" height="146" rx="28" fill="#111111" opacity="0.76"/>
  <line x1="48" y1="556" x2="342" y2="556" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- video -->
  <g>
    <rect x="42" y="503" width="54" height="42" rx="21" fill="#FFFFFF1F"/>
    <rect x="57" y="516" width="17" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="74,518 82,515 82,530 74,527" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="69" y="578" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Video</text>
  </g>

  <!-- speaker -->
  <g>
    <rect x="114" y="503" width="54" height="42" rx="21" fill="#FFFFFF1F"/>
    <polygon points="128,522 135,522 143,515 143,532 135,525 128,525" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="147" y1="518" x2="153" y2="529" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="153" y1="518" x2="147" y2="529" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="141" y="578" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Speaker</text>
  </g>

  <!-- mute -->
  <g>
    <rect x="186" y="503" width="54" height="42" rx="21" fill="#FFFFFF1F"/>
    <rect x="207" y="514" width="10" height="18" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <path d="M201 524 C201 534 223 534 223 524 M212 534 L212 538 M207 538 L217 538" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="201" y1="512" x2="222" y2="535" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="213" y="578" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Mute</text>
  </g>

  <!-- add -->
  <g>
    <rect x="258" y="503" width="54" height="42" rx="21" fill="#FFFFFF1F"/>
    <circle cx="285" cy="524" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="285" y1="518" x2="285" y2="530" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="279" y1="524" x2="291" y2="524" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="285" y="578" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Add</text>
  </g>

  <!-- hang up button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="145" y="652" width="100" height="58" rx="29" fill="#CB4949" opacity="0.28"/>
    <rect x="152" y="659" width="86" height="50" rx="25" fill="#D34646"/>
    <path d="M174 681 C182 672 208 672 216 681 L211 690 C205 687 185 687 179 690 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" transform="rotate(135 195 684)"/>
    <text x="195" y="735" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400">End call</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation / iPhone dock region -->
  <rect x="0" y="758" width="390" height="86" fill="#111111" opacity="0.92"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="758" x2="390" y2="758" stroke="#FFFFFF1F" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g>
    <circle cx="52" cy="786" r="21" fill="#FFFFFF0D"/>
    <polygon points="52,776 42,785 45,785 45,797 59,797 59,785 62,785" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="52" y="819" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400">Chats</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="129" cy="786" r="21" fill="#FFFFFF0D"/>
    <circle cx="129" cy="782" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="129" cy="794" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="129" y="819" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400">People</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="261" cy="786" r="21" fill="#FFFFFF0D"/>
    <rect x="249" y="777" width="24" height="17" rx="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polygon points="254,794 253,799 260,794" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="261" y="819" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400">Stories</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="338" cy="786" r="21" fill="#FFFFFF0D"/>
    <circle cx="338" cy="786" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="338" cy="786" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF80"/>
    <line x1="338" y1="773" x2="338" y2="770" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="338" y1="802" x2="338" y2="799" stroke="#FFFFFF80" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="338" y="819" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF80" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400">Settings</text>
  </g>

  <rect x="143" y="835" width="104" height="5" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
